prompt: pulumi fully_qualified_stack_name diy backend org requirement
answer:
For a DIY backend, the `org` portion of a fully qualified stack name must be the literal:

```text
organization
```

Thus, the fully qualified format is:

```text
organization/<project>/<stack>
```

For example:

```text
organization/app/prod
```

The value is constant and cannot be changed. DIY backends also accept `organization/<stack>` or simply `<stack>` when used from the project directory. This requires project-scoped stack support, available in Pulumi v3.61.0 and later; legacy DIY backends may support only the unqualified stack name.
